name: CaseGridAreaNonrectangular
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-area-nonrectangular" (grid-areas). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: area occupancy that cannot tile grid-template-areas (gapped or non-rectangular per CSS rules)
